lead: Lal Bahadur Shastri was a politician, born on 2 October 1904 in Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Nagar.
He died on 11 January 1966 in Tashkent at the age of 61.
He has held the office of Minister of External Affairs and Minister of Home Affairs and has been recognised with the Bharat Ratna.
Below you will find a verified overview of Lal Bahadur Shastri: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Lal Bahadur Shastri — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Minister of External Affairs (1964–1964), Minister of Home Affairs (1961–1963), Prime Minister of India (1964–1966) and Member of the Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
